title: SLeeLa Code LLM profile (version 1.0)
description: A declarative, USER-OWNED description of a code-specialized language model (coding assistant / program-aided LM) for procedural programming. SLeeLa ships no code model and selects none; this records the caller's choice, the procedural language, the enabled tasks, and the strongest verification the caller can provide (none/compile/test/trace).

model_id.description: The caller's code model; not shipped by SLeeLa.

other_language.description: Required in spirit when primary_language is 'other'.

tasks.description: The Code LLM uses the caller enables.

check_mode.description: Strongest verification available. 'none' means claims about behavior stay UNKNOWN (unverified).
